samples.summary: New mergeBlocks sweep is only tested for top-level body blocks; no test for a merge inside a table cell (or header/footer)
samples.evidence: The delta adds `dropStaleStyleOff(blockId)` to `Doc.mergeBlocks` (packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:388). That sweep resolves the block via `findBlock`, which for cell blocks goes through `findBlockInCells` (document.ts:209) — a parent-map fast path that is populated at layout time, with a `walkCellsForBlock` fallback. Model-level tests never run layout, so the cell path is a genuinely different code path. The two new tests (document.test.ts:415, 427) build only two top-level body blocks via `MemDocStore.setDocument({blocks:[...]})`. I grepped packages/docs/test for `mergeBlocks` (only test/model/document.test.ts:146,399 and test/model/table.test.ts:476-488, which predate this delta and assert only text merging, not style-off cleanup). So a merge-in-cell that strands an `italic:false` has no coverage either way.

samples.summary: Undo granularity of the merge + stale-flag sweep (two store writes for one Backspace) is asserted nowhere
samples.evidence: The sweep issues a second store write (`applyStyles` in `writeStaleStyleOffEdits`, document.ts:573) after `store.mergeBlock`, with no snapshot/batch seam — the same split the PR's own new comment in packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1048-1057 admits makes a named-style redefinition take two Cmd+Z under the Yorkie store. Neither of the two new tests touches undo, and I found no undo test for the merge path: packages/docs/test/store/memory.test.ts covers mergeBlock without undo, and packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.test.ts:261 is `it.skip('mergeBlock → undo → blocks restored')`. So a Backspace that strands a flag can regress to two undo steps with nothing failing.
searchedFor: Grep undo in packages/docs/test (8 files, none for mergeBlocks)
